title: Open-Vocabulary Functional 3D Human-Scene Interaction Generation

excluded_titles_checked: EmbodMocap: In-the-Wild 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction for Embodied Agents

summary: FunHSI is a training-free, functionality-driven framework for generating functionally correct 3D human-scene interactions from open-vocabulary task prompts. It reasons about functional scene elements, contact, body/hand pose, and stage-wise optimization for physical plausibility and functional correctness.
